title: Listening Section 1 Form Completion
content: In Section 1, predict the type of answer before listening: name, number, date, address, or noun. Check spelling and word limits. A common mistake is hearing the first option and missing the correction that follows.

title: Listening Section 3 Distractors
content: Section 3 often has students discussing choices. Listen for changes of opinion: at first, however, actually, on second thought. The correct answer may come after a rejected idea, so track who agrees and what final decision they reach.

title: Listening Section 4 Lecture Notes
content: Section 4 is a monologue, so use signposting to follow the structure: first, next, another issue, finally. Predict grammar for each blank. If the blank follows an adjective, the answer is probably a noun; if it follows a verb, it may be an object.
